inputs.research_brief: I live in a 38 m2 studio with a 45 cm-deep kitchen counter and 42 cm of clearance under the cabinets, and I want to compare three semi-automatic espresso machines for daily home use: the Breville Bambino Plus, Gaggia Classic Pro, and De'Longhi La Specialista Arte. My total purchase price including VAT and mandatory delivery must be strictly under USD 800; a price of exactly USD 800 does not qualify. Each machine must be no more than 35 cm deep and no more than 42 cm tall; exactly 35 cm deep and exactly 42 cm tall qualify. Each must have a steam wand and must be semi-automatic. Exclude pod or capsule machines, super-automatic machines, and used or refurbished units. Compare heat-up time, temperature stability, milk-steaming performance, footprint, ease of cleaning, and warranty on a consistent basis. A built-in grinder is preferred because counter space is limited, but models without one must not be excluded for that reason alone. I have no preferred bean brand or roast and no color preference, so keep those dimensions open. Prioritize manufacturer specifications for dimensions and features, authorized retailer listings for price and stock as of October 9, 2026, and reputable independent tests for real-world performance. Do not assume November availability from October listings. If no model meets all constraints, report that explicitly rather than relaxing a constraint.

I am planning a 5-day W-trek in Torres del Paine with one companion from February 10 to 18, 2027. We have moderate multi-day hiking experience, can walk up to 18 km per day, and do not do technical climbing. I want to compare two to three feasible itineraries that each include the Base of the Towers viewpoint and at least one Grey Glacier viewpoint day. First establish the 2026-2027 season rules, including CONAF entry quotas and fees, refugio and campsite booking windows, and any trail or sector closures, then assess only itineraries that comply with those rules. We will use public buses and park shuttles only; we do not want a rental car or private transfers. Refugio dorm beds are preferred for comfort, but tent campsites remain fully eligible and must not be excluded for lacking a bed. Our accommodation budget is at most USD 150 per person per night; exactly USD 150 qualifies, with meals assessed separately. Prioritize Spanish-language official CONAF, park concessionaire, and bus-operator sources, using useful English-language official sources where they clarify schedules or bookings. February 2027 timetables and fees may not yet be published, so do not present 2026 figures as guaranteed 2027 terms; flag unverified availability explicitly. If no compliant itinerary fits our fitness, budget, and bus-only constraints, report that gap explicitly rather than relaxing a requirement. I have not specified guiding services, so consider both self-guided and refugio-supported options without assuming one.

I am preparing an evidence review for primary-care counseling of sedentary adults aged 40 to 65, inclusive, with low baseline fitness, comparing high-intensity interval training with moderate-intensity continuous training for improving cardiorespiratory fitness. Exactly age 40 and exactly age 65 qualify. I want to understand effects on VO2max change, adherence and dropout, adverse events, and durability at six months or longer, compared with each other and with no-exercise control where head-to-head data are limited. Restrict eligible evidence to original randomized controlled trials in peer-reviewed English-language journals published from January 1, 2018 through December 31, 2025, inclusive. Exclude animal studies, single-session or acute-response studies, athlete-only samples, cardiac-rehabilitation-only samples, and reviews of any kind. Prefer the original paper or official journal publication over secondary summaries; secondary summaries may supplement but must not replace primary trial evidence. Extract VO2max change, adherence and dropout, adverse events, and durability on a comparable basis across trials, with risk-of-bias appraisal per trial, and report per-outcome gaps where evidence is thin. Investigate disagreements and distinguish absence of evidence from evidence of no benefit; if trials do not address an outcome adequately, that gap matters for counseling. I have not specified a particular HIIT protocol such as 4x4 or Tabata, so do not restrict the review to one protocol, and I have no preferred training setting.

I manage a seed-stage B2B SaaS company in Ireland processing about EUR 2 million per year in card payments with an average ticket of EUR 49 and roughly 70 percent EEA cards. I need to compare Stripe and Adyen for online card processing only; Checkout.com is outside the scope of this comparison, and in-person POS hardware is out of scope. Each option must support PSD2 SCA with 3D Secure 2, SEPA bank-debit collection, and webhooks for failed-payment handling. Estimate total recurring processing plus monthly fees for our volume using published list pricing as of September 30, 2026, assessing one-time implementation and migration costs separately; internal engineering labor is assessed separately and does not count toward the fee comparison. Our target is at most EUR 3,000 per month in processor fees under those assumptions; exactly EUR 3,000 qualifies, but a finding that neither meets the target on list pricing is acceptable if evidence shows so. Also assess migration of about 15,000 stored payment methods and ongoing operational burden for a two-person operations team. EU data residency is preferred given customer expectations, but lack of EU-only hosting must not alone disqualify an option. Use vendor documentation and pricing pages for capabilities and fees, plus reputable analyst or implementation-partner sources for operational considerations, substantiating key claims with docs, terms, or demonstrable behavior. If first-quarter 2027 terms cannot be verified, flag uncertainty rather than treating current offers as guaranteed. I have no preferred vendor and no mandatory fraud-tool requirement.

I am a policy analyst advising a city council on short-term rental regulation, and I need a comparison of the rules as applied in 2026 in Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Kyoto. For each city, determine host eligibility, primary-residence and licensing requirements, maximum nights per year, registration and tax-collection duties, and enforcement and penalties, plus major interaction with applicable national or regional law. Use official city, prefecture, and national government sources only; exclude broker blogs, listings platforms, and opinion pieces. Prioritize local-language official postings (Spanish and Catalan for Barcelona, Dutch for Amsterdam, Japanese for Kyoto) over English summaries where they differ, using English official translations only to clarify. Focus on citywide programs for entire-home and private-room rentals; exclude hotel regulation and long-term rent controls. Do not broaden the project into a general moral debate about whether tourism is good or bad. Base assessments on sources available as of October 9, 2026, and if 2027 rule changes cannot be verified, identify that uncertainty rather than treating current rules as guaranteed. If a provision cannot be verified in an official source, report that gap explicitly rather than filling it from broker or listings sources. Compare the three cities on a shared basis and note where urban density, enforcement capacity, or baseline housing access may affect interpretation. I have not specified a preferred regulatory model, target violation rate, or subsidy budget, so do not impose arbitrary thresholds; the goal is to assess evidence useful for a policy decision, not to assume stricter rules necessarily work.

I am a first-time homebuyer in Ohio evaluating a USD 385,000 purchase with 10 percent down, a 740 credit score, and no other debt, choosing among a 30-year fixed, 15-year fixed, and 5/1 ARM for a primary residence closing in mid-2027. First determine current 2026 conforming rate and fee baselines, points, private mortgage insurance thresholds, and ARM caps and reset mechanics from official sources, then assess how each of the three options performs for my profile under both a 6.00 percent and a 7.50 percent 30-year reference-rate scenario without treating either scenario as the forecast. Assess each option separately under both scenarios rather than averaging across scenarios. Assess monthly principal, interest, and PMI against my ceiling of USD 2,400 per month excluding taxes and insurance; exactly USD 2,400 qualifies, plus total 5- and 10-year cost, rate-reset risk, and qualification implications. Use CFPB, Freddie Mac, and lender Loan Estimate disclosures for rates and costs, checking benchmark relevance rather than applying national averages uncritically. If ARM caps, PMI removal terms, or 2027 pricing cannot be verified, flag that uncertainty explicitly. Interest-only, balloon, investment-property, and reverse-mortgage products are out of scope. I have not selected a down-payment assistance program, so do not assume one; investigate tax, insurance, and fee dependencies rather than silently choosing favorable assumptions.

I want to investigate how the Cuban Missile Crisis was represented to domestic audiences in the United States and the Soviet Union from October 16 through December 31, 1962, inclusive, comparing the timing and nature of press and broadcast coverage; both endpoints are in scope. For each side, identify recurring themes, depictions of the opposing bloc, descriptions of the crisis purpose and stakes, and evidence of intended domestic persuasion. Use contemporaneous newspapers, radio transcripts, government statements, posters, or archival collections from the period where available, supported by scholarly historical research. Include Russian-language Soviet press and broadcast sources for the Soviet side where available; English translations are preferred for access where available, but Russian originals must not be excluded for lacking a translation. Do not extend the study into later Cold War retrospectives except when an archive catalog is needed to locate a primary source, and do not broaden the project into comparisons with later crises or nuclear-policy debates in general. If Soviet broadcast transcripts or other primary sources are unavailable, report that gap explicitly rather than filling it from retrospectives. The goal is to understand 1962 representations, not to judge which side was morally right. I have no preferred interpretation and have not specified a particular newspaper, so keep outlet selection open within the contemporaneous source categories.

I have six years of experience as a secondary-school biology teacher in the United States, with strong lesson-planning and assessment skills, basic data literacy, and no professional coding experience, and I want to compare two transition targets: instructional designer and corporate trainer. For each role, research common responsibilities, core technical and facilitation skills, typical credentials or certificates, interview expectations, realistic skill gaps from my teaching starting point, and representative salary ranges from sources published in 2025 or 2026, inclusive. Older sources may supplement only if flagged as such. Remote work is preferred, while hybrid is acceptable; on-site-only roles are out of scope. Do not optimize the comparison for the highest salary, and do not assume a particular city, keeping location open within the United States. Exclude K-12 administration or principal roles and roles requiring a PhD or research doctorate, and exclude management-track roles. I have not selected a particular certificate program such as ATD or a specific MOOC, so keep credential options open. If salary or credential requirements cannot be verified in recent sources, report that gap explicitly. Use employer postings, professional-association guidance, and reputable labor-market sources, prioritizing primary postings for duties and official program pages for credential requirements.

I land at Inverness Airport at 21:15 on November 14, 2026 and need to reach Portree on the Isle of Skye by 01:00 on November 15 using public transport only. I can spend at most GBP 45 in total; a fare of exactly GBP 45 qualifies. I want no more than one transfer; one transfer qualifies. Onboard Wi-Fi is optional and must not decide the outcome. I do not want a rental car or private taxi. Please determine whether any workable public route exists by verifying deplaning plus airport-to-city transfer feasibility against the 21:15 landing, last Citylink, Stagecoach, or rail connections that night, total transfer count, total fare, and timetabled Portree arrival. A finding that no route meets all constraints is fully acceptable if evidence shows so; do not relax the arrival-time, transfer, budget, or public-transport requirements to manufacture an option. Use official airport, Traveline Scotland, Citylink, Stagecoach, and ScotRail sources for schedules, fares, and connection guidance. November 2026 timetables may not yet be published, so do not present 2025 times as guaranteed 2026 times; flag unverified availability explicitly. Treat mobile e-ticketing as a convenience, not a requirement.

I am a licensed home-county caterer planning to operate a taco food truck in the City of Aldergrove in 2026, and I need to know what additional city registration, general-liability insurance, health permit, fire inspection, or commissary-kitchen requirement applies before I can legally start. I hold a home-county caterer license, which I understand to authorize catering countywide; first establish what the county license actually covers from the county board, then determine the incremental city delta from the city code rather than assuming sufficiency either way. Treat same-day online filing as a convenience, not a requirement. My budget for total city registration and permit fees is at most USD 600; exactly USD 600 qualifies, with insurance and commissary costs assessed separately. A commissary-kitchen waiver is preferred if available, but lack of a waiver must not alone disqualify an otherwise compliant path; verify waiver eligibility rather than assuming it. I will not serve alcohol, so liquor licensing is out of scope; do not expand scope by cuisine unless official city or health sources state cuisine-specific handling rules, and if so report them. I have not specified a commissary kitchen, insurance limit, or filing method, so treat those as open verification targets, not assumed compliant. Prioritize the city code, health-department, and fire-marshal sources as of October 9, 2026, plus the county board for the county-versus-city distinction. If 2027 fees or forms cannot be verified, flag that uncertainty rather than treating 2026 postings as guaranteed. If a requirement cannot be verified from official sources, report that gap explicitly rather than assuming compliance.
